class.name: WorldsMeshTopology
class.brief_description: Optional CPU validation of indexed triangle topology and shared geometric borders.
class.description: WorldsMeshTopology inspects indices, coincident 3D positions, and ordered boundary samples without modifying the mesh. Exact-position welding can distinguish duplicated UV/material vertices from genuine open index edges, but does not weld approximately coincident vertices. None of the results certify watertight rasterization, self-intersection freedom or compatible materials. Compile with module_worlds_geometry_enabled=yes to use this experimental class.

method.name: analyze_indexed_surface
method.description: Counts invalid triangles, duplicate faces, zero-area triangles, open edges, nonmanifold edges, and winding conflicts by index identity. Returns a Dictionary containing [code]valid_input[/code], [code]closed_oriented_2manifold[/code] and per-category counts.

method.name: analyze_position_surface
method.description: Returns [code]indexed[/code] and [code]welded[/code] topology Dictionaries, plus [code]unique_positions[/code], [code]coincident_vertex_duplicates[/code] and [code]indexed_open_edges_resolved[/code]. Welding uses exact XYZ equality, not a distance tolerance. Position-based adjacency is diagnostic and does not change mesh vertices.

method.name: analyze_mesh_surface
method.description: Read-only analysis of a runtime Mesh or ArrayMesh triangle surface. The returned Dictionary contains source, surface, primitive, status, base, and lods. The base entry contains index_count, vertex_count, generated_indices, status and (on OK) an analysis Dictionary with indexed and welded connectivity reports. LOD entries use the same schema and preserve their distance metadata. Non-triangle primitives and malformed index streams are explicitly rejected. No mesh data is changed. The status OK only validates source-index preparation: check analysis.indexed.valid_input and the other diagnostics separately.

method.name: analyze_importer_mesh_surface
method.description: Inspects an ImporterMesh surface directly, including its native imported LOD index streams and surface name, without invoking get_mesh() or mutating import resources. Non-indexed triangle lists receive temporary sequential indices for diagnostics. The returned report distinguishes source stream validity from actual topological quality.

method.name: build_meshlets_mesh_surface
method.description: Experimentally partitions a runtime triangle surface or one of its stored LODs into meshlets using the built-in meshoptimizer library. A negative lod_level of -1 selects the base triangle stream; nonnegative indices select sorted LOD distances. Reports source, surface, LOD level and distance, meshlet counts, checked triangle coverage, and each cluster's sphere and normal-cone metadata. This does not modify the Mesh, build GPU buffers, generate simplified LODs, or produce automatically renderable resources. Requires the opt-in worlds_geometry and meshoptimizer modules. The status OK and verified true require a complete orientation-preserving triangle partition; neither implies safe visual seams or runtime performance.

method.name: build_meshlets_importer_surface
method.description: Inspects the original imported triangle surface or one of its stored LOD index streams without converting the resource or modifying its materials, skinning, or surface arrays. Each surface is clustered separately, preserving per-surface provenance. Generation is limited to 250000 source triangles per call. Malformed or nonfinite geometry and incorrect settings are rejected with a status. This method is experimental and not yet a virtual geometry renderer.

method.name: compare_border_samples
method.description: Compares two ordered 3D boundary polylines. Requires the same number of nondegenerate samples, with reversed vertex order. Any missing split vertex is flagged as a possible T-junction. A nonnegative [param tolerance] permits coordinate gaps up to that distance; this cannot certify fully crack-free triangles. Returns [code]valid_input[/code], [code]geometry_match[/code], [code]opposite_direction[/code], [code]same_direction[/code], [code]t_junction_risk[/code], [code]samples_a[/code], [code]samples_b[/code] and [code]max_opposing_gap[/code].
